task: Thread execution_id into ToolsService.find_tool_from_config as conversation_id so sequential bare workflow tool states share one AgentWorkspace instead of each getting a fresh random-UUID workspace.

key_reasoning.reason: Two components touched: ToolNode._execute_regular_tool (workflow layer) and ToolsService.find_tool_from_config (service layer). Downstream layers — ToolkitSettingService, AgentWorkspaceToolkit, AgentWorkspaceService, AgentWorkspaceRepository — require zero code changes; they already handle conversation_id correctly once it is populated upstream.

Exact reference pattern exists in ToolNode._execute_mcp_tool (same file, line ~139) which already passes conversation_id=self.execution_id. The fix is a copy-adapt of that pattern. The only non-trivial risk is that the fix activates AgentWorkspace tools for the bare tool-state path for the first time (previously the toolkit guard silently returned []); any latent bugs in AgentWorkspaceToolkit on the workflow path would be newly exposed. Rollback is a 3-line revert.
